citation: Moseley, Michael Edward. 1975. The Maritime Foundations of Andean Civilization. Menlo Park, Calif.: Cummings Publishing Company. xii, 131 p. ISBN (as catalogued) varies by printing.
notes: Classic secondary monograph arguing that early central-coast complexity rested substantially on marine resources, sedentism, cotton/net technology, and corporate monumental labor — not intensive agriculture alone. Highly influential and heavily debated (see Raymond 1981). Tier S scholarly model. Do not copy ‘maritime foundations’ as settled fact; label as Moseley’s model.
